lastCompletedStory.title: Thread -L cam through cam stop and Menu pane control

nextStoryContext: US-001 threaded -L cam through session.ts; US-002 through run.ts; US-003 through next.ts probe; US-004 through stop.ts and Menu.tsx default runTmux closure. Pattern: wrap all direct tmux spawn calls with tmuxArgs([...]). Fake spawn handlers in tests route by args[2] (the subcommand) not args[0], because args[0]==='-L' and args[1]==='cam' now. Guard: const sub = args[0] === '-L' ? args[2] : args[0]. setup-menu.test.ts tests a bash script template (buildSetupMenuScript in setup.ts) -- that script is out of scope for the -L cam threading; it still uses bare tmux calls.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only wraps existing tmux spawn calls with tmuxArgs() in stop.ts and Menu.tsx. No external library API surface changed.
